newsitem.title: USA: Motorola unit launches cable descrambler.
newsitem.headline: Motorola unit launches cable descrambler.

text.p: Motorola Inc said Wednesday its Multimedia Group introduced a cable television device that provides centralized descrambling of television signals.

The company said its new HomeClear Broadband Video System restores many television features that are restricted by conventional scrambling systems, including picture-in-picture and the use of original remote controls.
Motorola expects HomeClear, which is installed outside of a cable subscriber's residence, to be available commercially in the fall of 1997.
Motorola develops communications products, semiconductors and other electronic products.
Its shares were off 3/8 Wednesday at 56-3/4.
